svg.title: De Seure 1558: 118-sign working key
svg.text: Sign identifiers match KEY_AND_DECRYPTION.txt. ∅ = null; ? = tentative value.
Several of these characters are in fact letters from the Roman and Greek alphabets in secretarial hand.
This was not always clear at the start—hence names not reflecting that fact.
